meta.scope: Preserve S747 normal-rat to SNI stimulus-domain mismatch and unresolved accuracy values

records.title: A programmable and self-adaptive ultrasonic wireless implant for personalized chronic pain management

decisions.notes: Classifier entries came from normal rats exposed to 25/50/75 g Von Frey stimuli; the separate SNI experiment describes 3/7/14 g stimulus classes in six rats. The checked main text does not establish whether the classifier was reused unchanged, retrained or recalibrated across these conditions. The entry-level random split is not shown animal-disjoint, so same-animal leakage cannot be excluded (reviewer inference). Abstract/Methods report 94.8% accuracy, while Results also report 97.66% without explaining the relation in the checked main text; Supplementary Table 5 was not accessible in this pass. Labels are stimulus-linked nociceptive-response classes, not human subjective pain. No ECAP or human SCS outcome validation.

searches.query: S747 25 50 75 g normal rats versus 3 7 14 g SNI, 94.8 97.66 accuracy

updates.производительность: Abstract/Methods report 94.8% overall three-class accuracy on 5,570 training and 200 test entries; Results also report 97.66% for a ResNet model without resolving the relation in the checked main text. SNI conditioned-place-aversion comparison: n=6, P<0.0001.
